test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence that has a grammatical error.

options.text: She usually walks her dog in the park every morning.
The train leaves the station at 8:00 a.m. every day.
They play chess together on weekends.

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. He don't like spicy food .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence has a grammatical error in the use of the verb.
 
• In English, the correct form of the verb "do" in the third person singular is "does".
 
• The correct sentence should be "He doesn't like spicy food".

Correct sentence: *He **doesn't** like spicy food*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subject-Verb Agreement:**

 
 
• In English, verbs must agree with their subjects in number (singular or plural).
 
• For example, "He walks" (singular) vs. "They walk" (plural).
 
 
 
• **Contractions:**
 
 
• Contractions combine two words into one. For example, "does not" becomes "doesn't".
 
• They are commonly used in spoken and informal written English.
